items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had Hal Kemp to come way over -- he was playing in the city... he came over there to hear the band one noon, before the program.

ctx.x: This was earlier. This was before Charlie was -- Charlie was just a kid.

Played so much trombone. And, well, I played such arrangements, like William Tell, I had Hal Kemp to come over -- I played a school and I had Hal Kemp to come way over -- he was playing in the city, and you know Hal Kemp's band.
